بحثكم لحالكم؟ فريقكم ينتظركم: Working alone? Your team is waiting
رابط واحد بالقروب، وكل من يفتحه يدخل فري: One link in the group chat — anyone who opens it joins your team.
فريقكم {0} من 4 — كمّلوه: Your team is {0} of 4 — fill it up
رابط واحد بقروب الدفعة، وكل من يفتحه يدخ: One link in your class group — anyone who opens it joins your team. Tasks get split once the team is complete.
الرابط ما اشتغل معهم؟ انسخوا رمز الفريق: Link didn't work? Copy the team code
رابط واحد للدكتورة بدون حساب: تشوف تقدّم: One link for your supervisor, no account needed: she sees your progress, replies in the “With the doctor” group, and approves minutes and meetings. If she has other teams, they all show up on one dashboard.
الرابط وصل لأحد غير دكتورتكم؟: Did the link reach someone other than your supervisor?
تغيير الرابط يعطّل القديم فورًا، وتحتاجو: Changing the link disables the old one right away, and you'll need to send the new one to your supervisor. Only change it if it reached someone else.
